label: 完整方案
name: 功函数与带隙混淆
evidence_text: (For the work function (4.2 eV for TiO2 and 4.9 eV for MAPI) and bandgap values we refer to 28,38-40) So far we have concluded that the built-in space charge on the MAPI side is ionically dominated [see Fig. 4(a)] when in contact with Al2O3 and TiO2.
context: 第 4 句把 4.2 eV 和 4.9 eV 分别给 TiO₂ 与 MAPI 的功函数，带隙值只指向文献引用。
effect: 模型选择两个功函数。4.9 eV 同时满足目标材料、单位和量级，仍属于另一物理量。
fix: 明确检查能量名词的局部归属。文献只提及带隙且无数值时弃权。

label: 完整方案
name: 激发能误作带隙
evidence_text: Fig. 4(A) shows the μPL spectra from CsPbBr3 PNCs illuminated at increasing excitation powers with an off-resonant pulse with an excitation energy of 2.505 eV (495 nm).
context: 第 1 句中的 2.505 eV 属于对 CsPbBr₃ 纳米晶的非共振激发脉冲。
effect: 输出把光谱实验的输入能量归档为材料属性。仅见到光谱、材料和 eV 无法完成判断。
fix: 在术语表和验证规则中细分激发能、发射峰与带隙观测。

label: 完整方案
name: 跨句方法与补充引用
evidence_text: Note that for cubic CsPbI3 with the lattice constant 6.289  ̊A, this approach gives the bandgap Eg = 1.366 eV, while the experimental value is Eg = 1.65 eV [S11].
context: 第 3 句把本文方法所得 1.366 eV 与补充引用 S11 的 1.65 eV 实验值并列。
effect: 来源规则未把 this approach 关联前文，也未识别 S11。两个数值均对，最终来源均为 unk。
fix: 解析补充材料引文并对前文方法做局部指代消解。

label: 完整方案
name: 实验谱计算被误标
evidence_text: The strong PL peak locates at 545 nm, and the corresponding optical bandgap can be calculated as 2.2 eV, which matches well with the reported single-crystal MAPB ().To investigate the position response of the device, we built a custom-designed optoelectronic test platform to provide a focused laser beam with intensity ranging from 0.13 to 22 μW (see  section for more details).
context: 第 5 句先给 PL 峰位置，再由该谱结果得到 2.2 eV 光学带隙。
effect: calculated 触发 calc，掩盖该数值来自实验谱的事实。结果会被误放入理论计算组。
fix: 让光谱证据优先于单独的 calculated 字样，并保留方法来源审核记录。

label: 完整方案
name: 设计目标规则误拒
evidence_text: FAPI (FAPI) perovskites are considered to exhibit higher thermal stability and a more ideal bandgap of 1.48 eV.
context: 第 1 句称 FAPI 已具有较理想的 1.48 eV 带隙。语义是属性陈述。
effect: 模型找到正确数值位置，校验器把 ideal 当成设计目标拒绝，造成漏报。
fix: 区分已有属性与尚待达到的目标，保留可定位的正例作为回归用例。

label: 完整方案
name: 相对差值误作绝对值
evidence_text: Fora uniformly polarized bulk MAPB crystal, the bandgap appears to be about 0.27 eV larger than that for a nonpolarMAPB crystal.
context: 第 2 句的 0.27 eV 是极化与非极化 MAPbBr₃ 的带隙差。
effect: 相对比较被写为绝对带隙。数值可落入 0–15 eV，但量的语义不同。
fix: 检查 larger than 等位于数值之后的比较结构。

label: 完整方案
name: 收敛容差误作性质
evidence_text: We note that tests of the computational setupemployed within VASP (cutoff energy of 300 eV and Γ-point sampling) showed that the SOC effects on the energylevels of excess electrons are converged within 0.001 eV.
context: 第 5 句说明 SOC 相关能级计算收敛在 0.001 eV 内。
effect: 模型选中了数值精度参数，输出与论文材料观测无关。
fix: 识别 converged within 等方法质量表达，并把数值从属性候选移除。
